title: What's new in {{version}}
intro: A few changes worth knowing about:
items: Added 317 SRD 5.1 monsters (source: 'srd-5.1') to the Bestiary — available right away, no JSON import or manual entry needed.
Fixed the character sheet's shared-changes history: instead of raw field names (e.g. "combat.hp", "combat.conditions") it now shows readable labels ("Hit points", "Conditions", etc.).
